findings.reason: Scoped manual check: scope=call-count-only; `__input_l`: Ghidra has 62 CALL instructions and the exact-hash MSVC 2022 x86 `/O2` candidate object has 66. The direct/import and indirect callback targets map; the four excess sites are accounted for by one additional compiler cookie-check call and three extra static `_isdigit` sites. Ghidra has one call site in each of three digit-scanning loops; MSVC emits each loop's first-condition test separately from its repeat/loop-back test (pairs at object offsets `0x9d6/0xa34`, `0xab9/0xb18`, and `0xbe9/0xc40`), so each pair executes as successive iterations, not as two calls per iteration. The two radix-specific digit checks and format-width check map one-to-one; both `_isleadbyte` sites also match. The candidate's two mutually exclusive exponent-digit loops converge to the same continuation, corresponding to Ghidra's shared exponent loop. Suppress only the source-expression call-count heuristic; retain all other findings. Static disassembly/control-flow review only, not semantic or runtime validation.
